genesis.33.p1.b1.text: Now Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming toward him with four hundred men. …

genesis.33.p1.b2.text: He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

genesis.33.p1.b3.text: But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.

genesis.33.p2.b2.text: … and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him.

genesis.33.p3.b2.text: “These are the children God has graciously given your servant.”

genesis.33.p3.b3.text: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down. Leah and her children also approached and bowed down, …

genesis.33.p3.b4.text: … and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down.

genesis.33.p4.b1.text: “What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?”

genesis.33.p4.b2.text: “I already have plenty, my brother,” Esau replied. “Keep what belongs to you.”

genesis.33.p4.b3.text: … For indeed, I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God, since you have received me favorably.

genesis.33.p4.b4.text: … So Jacob pressed him until he accepted.

genesis.33.p5.b1.text: “Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.”

genesis.33.p5.b2.text: “My lord knows that the children are frail, and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. …

genesis.33.p5.b3.text: “Why do that? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

genesis.33.p5.b4.text: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir,

genesis.33.p6.b1.text: … Jacob went on to Succoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock; …

genesis.33.p6.b2.text: … he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and he camped just outside the city.

genesis.33.p6.b3.text: And the plot of ground where he pitched his tent, he purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver. There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
